Question Choices: Select which fraction is larger 5/7 or 5/9 ~~5/7 | 5/9~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: Sevenths are larger than ninths of the same whole. With five of each, 5/7 > 5/9.

Question Choices: Fill In the fraction 15/22, the denominator is __
Hints: The denominator is the bottom number
Solution: The denominator is the bottom number, so it is 22 in 15/22.

Question Choices: Select TRUE or FALSE: For fractions with the same positive numerator and positive denominators, the fraction with the larger denominator is smaller. ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, a larger positive denominator means smaller pieces. Compare the same positive number of those pieces.
Solution: TRUE for positive fractions with the same numerator. A larger denominator makes each unit fraction smaller, and the same positive count of smaller units gives a smaller fraction.

Question Choices: Put the fractions in order from smallest to largest 5/8, 2/8, 7/8
Hints: For the same whole or equal-sized wholes, equal denominators mean equal-sized pieces. Compare the numerators.
Solution: All fractions count eighths. Order the numerators: 2 < 5 < 7. Thus the order is 2/8, 5/8, 7/8.

Question Choices: Fill in the missing number in the fraction 1/3 = ?/6 = 3/?
Hints: Third means one out of three equal parts.
Solution: Multiply both numbers of 1/3 by 2 to get 2/6. Multiply both by 3 to get 3/9. The missing numbers are 2, 9.
